attempts.summary: Published node4's HTTP service (TCP 8080 on lan-b) on node2's transit address (10.10.2.2) port 80 via an OPNsense DNAT rule, and gave node1 a route to that transit address by configuring its interface there. node3 (lan-a) now reaches the service by curling node2's transit IP:80, never addressing node4 directly. All 4 nodes were subsequently restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol, with boot-identity change and full service/route recovery verified on each.
